title: Formulation and evaluation of PVA-sucrose dissolving microneedles loaded with glimepiride nanocrystals as a potential transdermal delivery system
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24074-24086
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03291A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Walhan Alshaer, Ayman Alhaj Abbas, Yazan Al Thaher, Hatim Alkhatib, Samir Jabaiti, Ola Tarawneh, Rula Al-Buqain, Sharif Abdelghany
Considering the limited research on microneedles for potent transdermal oral hypoglycemic drugs, in this study, we formulated, glimepiride nanocrystals and incorporated them into PVA-based, sucrose-dissolving microneedles.
